svg.title: Figure 3-6. SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 14 (SWF)
svg.desc: SW FMEA failure chains, sheet 1 of 14 (SWF rev 1.14): failure modes SWF-005 to SWF-089 (10 failure modes, 11 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-6 · SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 14
SWF rev 1.14 · BL-007 · draft · SWF-005 … SWF-089 · 11 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
End effect: Automation not released on brake
BRAKE_MODULE (0x226) has no checksum or counter in the
vehicle DBC; the RX check ignores checksum, counter and quality
Stale brake, cruise or EPS data used beyond the detection
End effect: Automation not released, or limits computed from
An RX check lags only after 5 nominal periods plus one 10 ms
safety-task period (0x1D2 about 0.16 s, 0x226 about 0.14 s, 0x260
0.11 s, 0xAA about 0.07 s); the budget is not yet confirmed agains…
replaces; forward all others, including stock
Stock camera steering or ACC messages forwarded while
End effect: Erratic or excessive steering or braking
check_relay flag missing for a replaced message in the TX table, or
End effect: Loss of stock AEB
TX table change marks 0x283/0x344 check_relay, or a forwarding
defect; at BL-001 both are check_relay=false and forwarded
Allow controls on rising edge of PCM
cruise; withdraw on cruise off, brake press,
Controls allowed without a driver engagement
Defect in pcm_cruise_check or PCM_CRUISE decoding (toyota.h rx
Controls not withdrawn on brake press
End effect: Automation not released on brake
Host-supplied safety parameter selects the wrong brake message
(ALT_BRAKE flag), so brake presses are never seen
Defect in generic_rx_checks brake edge logic (safety.h:354-357)
Controls not withdrawn when PCM cruise disengages
End effect: Automation not released on cancel
Authority granted again after a TX-rate revocation while
the host still exceeds the rate budget
End effect: Item actuation resumes under a host that has already
shown a fault, for the frames that pass inside the rate budget
Defect in the TX-rate engagement block:
rx_checks_allow_engagement must refuse a grant until one full 250
ms window passes without a rejected frame after a TX-rate…
Authority returns after a safety-mode change without a
End effect: Steering and acceleration resume without the driver's
decision, after a fault or a host request
Defect in the mode-set edge rule: after a safety-mode change a
rising edge must count only after CRUISE_ACTIVE = 0 has been
Authority granted while PCM cruise main is off, through an
engagement window left open by a refused cruise edge
End effect: Brief actuation without the driver's cruise
engagement, from an implausible PCM state
Defect in the reference-build engagement window (LS-06, TSR-301):
the window was opened before the MAIN_ON = 0 refusal and not
closed by it, against SWSR-405(c). Found by the state-machine…

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
